encoding: H.264 High, 3840x2160, yuv420p limited-range BT.709 progressive; nominal 60 fps, reported average 59.97
method: Two decodes at 640x360, native passthrough versus fps=60, compared by frame hash multiset. Native-only scan uses three-frame luminance drop with spatial patch scoring. No fps filter in the native scan. PTS in the contact labels is rounded to the framemd5 stream 1/60 time base; frame index preserves native order.
visual_review: All 30 strongest spatial darkening candidates reviewed as before/current/after triplets. Largest candidates are foreground weapon/foliage/camera motion. No conclusively identified mountain-blackening frame. This is a negative observation, not proof of absence.
remaining: Exact affected mountain/frame or another reproducible sequence; whether the effect persists with native NVIDIA FG disabled. Current test GPUs do not support the recording’s native NVIDIA FG path.
